transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Sana. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am so frustrated! My internet is barely working and I just saw a huge overcharge on my last bill. This is ridiculous!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you are experiencing these issues, Mr. Johnson. I can certainly help you get this sorted out.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number for verification?
Customer: Fine. My account number is 16508321.
Agent: Thank you. And just to confirm, are you calling from the phone number 97721 23530?
Customer: Yes, that is correct. My name is Rahul Johnson.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Johnson. I have accessed your account. Regarding the network issue, I have run a diagnostic and it looks like there is a signal drop-off. I will raise a network ticket to have our engineers investigate the local tower.
Customer: I hope it is fixed soon. Now, what about this charge? I was charged twice for the same service package.
Agent: I see the error here. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge immediately.
Agent: Please keep in mind that any refund or credit is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to process.
Agent: Trust me, the money will definitely be back in your account by tomorrow.
Customer: That is a great relief. Thank you for taking care of this so quickly, Sana.
Agent: You are very welcome. To summarize, I have raised a network ticket for your internet and a refund request for the overcharge. Is there anything else I can help you with today? If not, have a wonderful day. Goodbye!
